Less flexible than MLPs for complex geometries.

Suitable for forward-facing and bounded scenes.
- **When Not to Use:** For very large unbounded scenes where memory is a constraint, or when high-frequency details require very high grid resolutions.
It builds on the idea of differentiable volume rendering but replaces the neural network representation with direct voxel grids.
The method was developed to address the slow training times of NeRF.
